response.text: {"name":"Spust v pesek","idea":"The page is a vertical cut through the Bizeljsko hill: a bright strip of vineyard at the top, a thin ground line marked 1897, and then everything below sinks into the dark sand of the old cellar where the wine has waited since that year.","palette":[{"role":"background","hex":"#1b1511"},{"role":"surface","hex":"#eaece6"},{"role":"text","hex":"#ece6dc"},{"role":"muted","hex":"#9c9183"},{"role":"primary","hex":"#c8893a"},{"role":"onPrimary","hex":"#1b1511"},{"role":"border","hex":"#3a3027"},{"role":"band","hex":"#c8893a"},{"role":"onBand","hex":"#1b1511"}],"pairing":"fraunces-source-sans","typeCharacter":"Fraunces is soft, old and slightly wonky, like a hand-set cellar label; it carries the h1 at about 10vw in regular weight with tight leading, the big numerals (4, 6, 1897) at 8vw, and section headings at 4vw, all sentence case. Source Sans 3 does every running line at 18px with generous leading, the week strip at 16px, never bold, never uppercase.","composition":"Section 1, hero, light field #eaece6 behind all 12 columns, 3 rows: the h1 sits in columns 1 to 10 across two lines, dark ink #1b1511; the lead in Source Sans spans columns 1 to 5 beneath it; a single square-cornered ochre button 'Rezervirajte degustacijo' sits left under the lead. Columns 9 to 12 of rows 1 and 2 hold a simple line drawing in dark ink of five slanted rows of vine stakes on a hill, short vertical strokes on a gently rising line. The last row of the hero is a single hairline rule across all 12 columns, with the small Fraunces numeral '1897' sitting just above it at column 12, right-aligned: the ground line. Section 2, story, page ground #1b1511, 3 rows: columns 1 to 4 stack two giant ochre Fraunces numerals, '4' with 'generacije vinogradnikov' beneath in muted Source Sans, and '6' with 'hektarjev vinogradov'; columns 6 to 12 carry the heading 'Stara klet, vkopana v pesek' at 4vw in text colour #ece6dc, then the story paragraph spanning columns 6 to 11, naming the brothers Gregor and Tomaž. The third row is a ribbon of short words in muted colour separated by ochre dots: zidanica, stara klet, pesek, penina, klasična metoda. Section 3, services, same dark ground, 4 rows, no cards: each offering is one row divided by a hairline in #3a3027, name in Fraunces 2.4vw in columns 1 to 5, description in Source Sans columns 6 to 10, leaving columns 11 and 12 empty as the dark edge of the cellar. Section 4, hours and address, ochre band #c8893a behind all 12 columns with dark ink: heading 'Kdaj vas pričakujemo' columns 1 to 6; the opening hours as a week strip in columns 1 to 6 below; the phone as a large Fraunces numeral at 5vw in columns 1 to 6 at the bottom; columns 8 to 12 hold the address 'Bizeljska cesta 112, 8259 Bizeljsko' and a simple schematic line map in dark ink. Section 5, call, dark ground, 2 rows: heading 'Rezervirajte degustacijo' at 5vw in columns 1 to 8, the two lines of call copy in columns 1 to 6, the email as a plain ochre underlined link, and the single button for this screen in ochre at column 1. On phones every section stacks in one column in the same order, the ground-line rule kept as a full-width divider between light and dark.","imagery":"No photographs anywhere.
